nodes.n: Midnight. The office is dark except for one desk lamp. Harsh Malhotra is sitting where his late wife's photo stands, holding a glass he isn't drinking.

nodes.t: A ladder. In my own house. My mother-in-law holding the torch. Do you know how that feels, Sonpur?
Sit. I'm not going to shout. I'm too tired.
I started this team with my wife. She painted the first logo herself. When she died, the team was all I had left of her. So I borrowed. And borrowed.
Here is my offer. A three-year contract, double money, a house for your mother in Sonpur. And you never speak to my daughter again.

choice.t: "Kunal plans to take your team after the wedding. I heard him."
"I don't want your money. I want her to choose."

nodes.t: Think fast. You have until the semi-final.
Kunal? Kunal has been at my table for ten years. You've been in my city for ten weeks.
Bring me proof, or never say that name in this office again.
...My wife said that to her father. Word for word. He didn't speak to her for six years.
Get out. Before I start to like you.

nodes.n: 3 AM. You can't sleep. Your real phone rings. Maa, from Sonpur. She never calls this late.

msgs.t: Beta, two men came to the shop today.
They said the bank loan on our house is paid. All of it.
They left a card. Sethi Steel. Who are these people? What did you do?

nodes.cliff: Sethi just bought your mother's house. And everyone has a price.
